_ua_gateway.common.ALLTYPES_DESCRIPTION: The parent interface of the OPC UA Gateway. Configuring this interface and managing the Instance Certificate view will allow communication between the UA Gateway service, its children interfaces, and the rest of Kepware+.

ua_client_interfaces.common.ALLTYPES_DESCRIPTION: The client interface of the OPC UA Gateway. Configuring this interface and adding client connections will allow communication between the OPC UA Gateway and other OPC UA servers.

ua_server_interfaces.common.ALLTYPES_DESCRIPTION: The server interface of the OPC UA Gateway. Configuring this interface and adding server endpoints will allow other OPC UA clients to connect to the OPC UA Gateway.
